blocks.text: 2703 58 Keefer Place Downtown VW Vancouver V6B 0B8

parts.t: Experience breathtaking 180° views of the city, mountains, and water from this stunning 2 bed, 2 bath home on the 27th floor of the highly sought-after Firenze building. Located in the heart of downtown, you’re just steps from Rogers Arena, BC Place, Costco, the Seawall, SkyTrain, shops, top restaurants, Crosstown Elementary, and Andy Livingstone Park. This beautifully updated unit features a custom brick accent wall, luxury laminate flooring, stainless steel appliances, and premium finishes throughout. Building amenities include an indoor pool, hot tub, fitness centre, 1 secure parking stall, and a rare bonus storage locker. A rare opportunity.
